page.layout: One printed page, title page only. Centred title block in large capitals and italic display type, with no running head, page number or other text.
page.notes: The faint mirrored text at the top (a running head reading "COMMENT. IN EPIST. PETRI II." and the large ghosted letters "JOHANNIS APOSTOLI CATHOLICAS" on the left and right) is show-through from the facing page and is omitted. The faint "Pag. 1" at the top right is not clearly printed and is omitted. The "IN" is set as a large initial with a swash N, transcribed as IN.
